## Sudoku TUI App: Features & Keybindings Reference

Based on my thorough exploration of the codebase, here's a comprehensive guide for creating VHS demo recordings:

### 1. KEYBINDINGS/CONTROLS

#### Menu Navigation
- **w / s** or **arrow keys**: Move through menu items
- **Enter** / **Space**: Select menu item
- **Esc** or **q**: Go back / Quit
- **Ctrl+C**: Force quit (only available from menu)

#### In-Game (Game Screen)
- **w / a / s / d** or **arrow keys**: Move cursor on board
- **1-9**: Place a digit in the current cell
- **Shift+1-9** (!, @, #, $, %, ^, &, *, ()): Place digit as note
- **n**: Toggle between Digit Mode and Note Mode
- **x**, **Backspace**, or **Delete**: Erase content from current cell
- **u** or **Ctrl+Z**: Undo last move
- **Esc** or **q**: Abandon game and return to menu
- **Enter** (after puzzle solved): Return to menu from victory screen

#### Library Navigation
- **w / s** or **arrow keys**: Scroll puzzle list
- **PgDn / PgUp**: Page down/up through puzzles
- **Tab**: Cycle through difficulty filters (All → Easy → Medium → Hard → Expert → All)
- **Enter**: Load selected puzzle
- **Esc** or **q**: Return to menu

#### History Navigation
- **w / s** or **arrow keys**: Scroll through history entries
- **PgDn / PgUp**: Page through history (8 entries per page)
- **Esc** or **q**: Return to menu

---

### 2. MENU SCREEN OPTIONS

**Main Menu items** (varies based on game state):
- **Resume Game** (appears if game in progress, can be dismissed by starting new game)
- **New Game** → Opens Difficulty Selector
- **Puzzle Library** → Browse curated puzzles
- **History** → View completed games
- **Themes** → Select visual theme
- **Quit** → Exit application

**Difficulty Selector Modal** shows:
- Easy (36-40 clues): "Solvable with naked and hidden singles only. A warm-up."
- Medium (30-35 clues): "Requires naked pairs and pointing pairs. Good daily practice."
- Hard (25-29 clues): "Advanced patterns required. Focused solving needed."
- Expert (17-24 clues): "X-Wing, Y-Wing, and Swordfish. Not for the faint-hearted."

**Theme Selector Modal** shows 4 available themes:
1. **Modern Charm** (default)
2. **Zen Monolith**
3. **Retro Phosphor**
4. **Matrix**

Current theme marked with ✓

---

### 3. LIBRARY SCREEN

**Browse & Select Puzzles:**
- Left panel: Scrollable list of curated puzzles with difficulty badges (EASY, MEDIUM, HARD, EXPERT)
- Right panel: Detail view of selected puzzle showing:
  - Puzzle name
  - Difficulty level
  - Author name
  - Description text
  - URL reference (if available)
  - ASCII preview of the puzzle grid (showing givens as numbers, empty as dots)
  - "[ Enter ] LOAD PUZZLE" button

**Filter Bar** at top:
- 5 filter chips: ALL, EASY, MEDIUM, HARD, EXPERT
- Current filter highlighted
- **Tab** key cycles through filters
- Puzzles auto-sorted: by difficulty (if no filter), or alphabetically (if filter active)

**Navigation:**
- Cursor shown as "▶" marker on list
- PgDn/PgUp for faster scrolling
- List updates scroll offset automatically

---

### 4. HISTORY SCREEN

**Statistics Box** (top of screen):
- TOTAL GAMES count
- WIN RATE percentage
- BEST (HARD) time
- STREAK counter

**History Table** (paginated, 8 entries per page):
- Columns: DATE (16 chars) | DIFFICULTY | TIME | RESULT
- Result shown as badge: "WIN" (styled) or "GAVE UP" (styled)
- Current row marked with ">" prefix
- Pagination info: "SHOWING X-Y OF Z   PAGE P/Q"

**Navigation:**
- w/s: Scroll entries one at a time
- PgDn/PgUp: Jump to next/previous page

---

### 5. GAME SCREEN FEATURES

**Main Board Display:**
- 9×9 grid with ASCII art borders (box drawing characters)
- Cells displayed in 7-char width, 3-line height format
- Big digit display (using box-drawing characters)

**Cell Highlighting:**
- **Cursor cell**: Highlighted with cursor color
- **Same number**: Other cells with same digit as cursor are highlighted
- **Note matches**: Empty cells with matching note highlighted
- **Row/column band**: Cells in same row/column as cursor highlighted
- **Conflict cells**: Red highlighting for sudoku rule violations
- **Given cells**: Clue numbers (non-editable)
- **User-placed cells**: User-entered digits

**Notes Display:**
- 3×3 small digit grid within each cell (1-9 layout)
- Shows which candidates are possible when in Note Mode
- Toggled via **n** key

**Left Sidebar (always visible):**
- **ELAPSED TIME** section: Running timer (MM:SS format)
- **INPUT MODE** section: Shows "● DIGIT" or "● NOTE " indicator
- **REMAINING** section: For each digit 1-9:
  - Digit number
  - Progress bar (█ filled, ░ empty)
  - Count of remaining placements
  - "DONE" message when digit complete (shown in different color)
  - Active digit in current cursor is highlighted

**Footer Bar:**
- Shows available keys: "wasd Move", "1-9 Digit", "n Mode", "x Erase", "u Undo", "Esc/q Menu"

**Toast Notifications** (technique detection):
- Appears above footer, 3-second duration
- Triggered when placing a digit that matches detected technique
- Messages by technique:
  - "Naked Single — only one candidate left!"
  - "Hidden Single — nice deduction."
  - "Naked Pair detected! Great pattern."
  - "Pointing Pair! Locked candidates found."
  - "✦ X-Wing detected! Nice move."
  - "✦ Y-Wing! Impressive technique."
  - "✦ Swordfish! Master-level solve."

**Victory Screen:**
- Large centered modal showing:
  - Victory badge (styled)
  - Title: "Puzzle Solved!"
  - Subtitle text
  - Stat box with TIME and DIFFICULTY
  - "[ PRESS ENTER ]" button
  - Secondary text: "Return to Menu (Esc/q)"
- Celebration animation: 25 particles spawned every 20 frames, falling downward with gravity (90 frame total animation)
  - Particles use characters: *, +, ., o, #, @, ^, ~
  - Colors cycle through theme palette

---

### 6. THEME SWITCHING

**4 Available Themes:**
1. **modern-charm** - Default theme (balanced colors)
2. **zen-monolith** - Monochromatic, minimalist
3. **retro-phosphor** - CRT/phosphor style (vintage look)
4. **matrix** - Green terminal/Matrix style

**Theme Access:**
- Via Menu → Themes
- Select with w/s navigation, Enter to apply
- Current theme marked with ✓
- Selected theme saved to disk automatically
- All screens (menu, game, library, history) update instantly to new theme

---

### 7. FOOTER/HELP TEXT

**Menu Screen Footer:**
```
w/s Navigate   Enter Select   Esc/q Quit
```

**Game Screen Footer:**
```
wasd Move   1-9 Digit   n Mode   x Erase   u Undo   Esc/q Menu
```

**Library Screen Footer:**
```
w/s Scroll   PgDn/PgUp Page   Tab Filter   Enter Load   Esc/q Back
```

**History Screen Footer:**
```
w/s Scroll   PgDn/PgUp Page   Esc/q Back
```

**Difficulty/Theme Modals Footer:**
```
w UP  s DOWN  Esc/q BACK  Enter SELECT
```

---

### KEY SEQUENCES FOR VHS DEMOS

For effective recordings, consider these demo flows:

1. **Main Menu Navigation**: Show menu selection with "Resume Game" option appearing after first game completion
2. **Difficulty Selection**: Demonstrate 4 difficulty levels with descriptions
3. **Gameplay**: Show digit placement (1-9), note mode (Shift+digits, n key), undo (u), erase (x)
4. **Technique Toasts**: Strategically place digits to trigger technique detection messages
5. **Library Browsing**: Filter by difficulty, preview puzzle, show detail panel
6. **History View**: Show pagination, stats, filter results
7. **Theme Cycling**: Change between 4 themes to show visual variety
8. **Victory Screen**: Complete puzzle to show celebration animation and stats display

All screens enforce minimum terminal size of **80×24 characters**.

# Complete VHS .Tape File Syntax Reference

Based on the official VHS documentation and source code, here's everything you need to create tape files from scratch:

## 1. All Available Commands

### Output & Setup Commands

| Command | Syntax | Purpose | Example |
|---------|--------|---------|---------|
| **Output** | `Output <path>` | Specify output file (supports .gif, .mp4, .webm, .png, .txt) | `Output demo.gif` |
| **Require** | `Require <program>` | Declare dependencies; fails early if missing | `Require bash` `Require echo` |
| **Source** | `Source <file.tape>` | Include/execute commands from another tape file | `Source setup.tape` |

### Text Input Commands

| Command | Syntax | Purpose | Example |
|---------|--------|---------|---------|
| **Type** | `Type "<text>"` | Simulate typing at configured speed | `Type "echo hello"` |
| **Type@speed** | `Type@<duration> "<text>"` | Type with speed override for this command | `Type@100ms "slow typing"` |
| **Copy** | `Copy "<text>"` | Copy text to clipboard | `Copy "my text"` |
| **Paste** | `Paste` | Paste clipboard contents | `Paste` |

### Key & Navigation Commands

| Command | Syntax | Purpose | Example |
|---------|--------|---------|---------|
| **Enter** | `Enter [count]` | Press Enter key (optional repeat count) | `Enter` or `Enter 3` |
| **Tab** | `Tab [count]` | Press Tab key | `Tab` or `Tab 2` |
| **Space** | `Space [count]` | Press Space key | `Space 5` |
| **Backspace** | `Backspace [count]` | Press Backspace | `Backspace 3` |
| **Delete** | `Delete [count]` | Press Delete key | `Delete 2` |
| **Escape** | `Escape` | Press Escape key | `Escape` |
| **Insert** | `Insert` | Press Insert key | `Insert` |
| **Up** | `Up [count]` | Arrow Up key | `Up 3` |
| **Down** | `Down [count]` | Arrow Down key | `Down 5` |
| **Left** | `Left [count]` | Arrow Left key | `Left 2` |
| **Right** | `Right [count]` | Arrow Right key | `Right 4` |
| **Page Up** | `PageUp [count]` | Page Up key | `PageUp` |
| **Page Down** | `PageDown [count]` | Page Down key | `PageDown 2` |
| **Home** | `Home` | Home key | `Home` |
| **End** | `End` | End key | `End` |

### Modifier Commands (Ctrl, Alt, Shift)

| Syntax | Purpose | Example |
|--------|---------|---------|
| `Ctrl+<key>` | Control sequence | `Ctrl+C`, `Ctrl+L`, `Ctrl+U` |
| `Alt+<key>` | Alt modifier | `Alt+F` |
| `Shift+<key>` | Shift modifier (v0.7.0+) | `Shift+Right`, `Shift+End` |
| `Ctrl+Alt+<key>` | Ctrl+Alt combination | `Ctrl+Alt+L` |
| `Ctrl+Shift+<key>` | Ctrl+Shift combination | `Ctrl+Shift+V` |

### Scrolling Commands

| Command | Syntax | Purpose | Example |
|---------|--------|---------|---------|
| **Scroll Up** | `ScrollUp [count]` | Scroll viewport up | `ScrollUp 3` |
| **Scroll Down** | `ScrollDown [count]` | Scroll viewport down | `ScrollDown 5` |

### Timing Commands

| Command | Syntax | Purpose | Example |
|---------|--------|---------|---------|
| **Sleep** | `Sleep <duration>` | Pause frame capture | `Sleep 500ms`, `Sleep 2s`, `Sleep 1` |
| **Wait** | `Wait [/regex/]` | Block until pattern appears (default: `/>$/`) | `Wait /prompt/`, `Wait /Error/` |

### Recording Control Commands

| Command | Syntax | Purpose | Example |
|---------|--------|---------|---------|
| **Hide** | `Hide` | Stop capturing frames (for setup) | `Hide` |
| **Show** | `Show` | Resume capturing frames | `Show` |
| **Screenshot** | `Screenshot <path>` | Capture current frame as PNG | `Screenshot frame.png` |

### Environment Variables

| Command | Syntax | Purpose | Example |
|---------|--------|---------|---------|
| **Env** | `Env <KEY> <VALUE>` | Set environment variable | `Env DEBUG true` |

---

## 2. All Available Set Options

All `Set` commands must appear **before non-setting commands**. (Exception: `TypingSpeed` can be set anywhere.)

### Display & Typography Options

| Option | Values | Purpose | Example |
|--------|--------|---------|---------|
| **FontSize** | pixels (integer) | Character size | `Set FontSize 32` |
| **FontFamily** | font name (string) | Typeface | `Set FontFamily "JetBrains Mono"` |
| **Width** | pixels (integer) | Terminal width | `Set Width 1200` |
| **Height** | pixels (integer) | Terminal height | `Set Height 600` |
| **LetterSpacing** | pixels (integer) | Space between characters | `Set LetterSpacing 20` |
| **LineHeight** | decimal (e.g., 1.5) | Line spacing multiplier | `Set LineHeight 1.8` |

### Visual Style Options

| Option | Values | Purpose | Example |
|--------|--------|---------|---------|
| **Theme** | theme name or JSON | Color scheme | `Set Theme "Dracula"` or `Set Theme "Catppuccin Frappe"` |
| **Padding** | pixels | Frame interior spacing | `Set Padding 10` |
| **Margin** | pixels | Frame exterior spacing | `Set Margin 5` |
| **BorderRadius** | pixels | Window corner rounding | `Set BorderRadius 8` |
| **WindowBar** | style name | Title bar decoration | `Set WindowBar Colorful`, `Set WindowBar Rings` |

### Behavior & Timing Options

| Option | Values | Purpose | Example |
|--------|--------|---------|---------|
| **Shell** | shell name | Command interpreter | `Set Shell "bash"`, `Set Shell "fish"`, `Set Shell "zsh"` |
| **TypingSpeed** | duration | Delay between keystrokes | `Set TypingSpeed 50ms`, `Set TypingSpeed 0.1s` |
| **Framerate** | fps (integer) | Capture frequency | `Set Framerate 30` |
| **PlaybackSpeed** | decimal multiplier | Output speed (0.5 = half speed, 2.0 = double) | `Set PlaybackSpeed 1.5` |
| **WaitTimeout** | duration | Max time to wait for pattern | `Set WaitTimeout 30s` |
| **CursorBlink** | true/false | Cursor animation | `Set CursorBlink false` |

### Advanced Options

| Option | Values | Purpose | Example |
|--------|--------|---------|---------|
| **LoopOffset** | frame number or percentage | Where GIF loop starts | `Set LoopOffset 5`, `Set LoopOffset 50%` |

## 3. Special Key Names & Syntax

### Basic Special Keys

```
Backspace
Delete
Insert
Escape
Enter
Tab
Space
```

### Arrow Keys

```
Up    [count]
Down  [count]
Left  [count]
Right [count]
```

### Navigation Keys

```
Home
End
PageUp   [count]
PageDown [count]
```

### Modifier Combinations

All support these modifier patterns:

```
Ctrl+C              (single key)
Ctrl+Shift+V        (key with modifiers)
Alt+F               (Alt modifier)
Ctrl+Alt+L          (multiple modifiers)
Shift+Right 3       (modifier with repeat count)
```

### Common Key Sequences

```
Ctrl+C      (interrupt)
Ctrl+D      (EOF/exit)
Ctrl+L      (clear screen)
Ctrl+U      (kill line backward)
Ctrl+E      (end of line)
Ctrl+A      (beginning of line)
Ctrl+V      (paste, often)
```

---

## 4. Type Command Details

### Basic Typing

```tape
Type "hello world"
```

### Per-Command Speed Override

Override the global `TypingSpeed` for a single command:

```tape
Set TypingSpeed 50ms          # Default speed
Type "normal speed text"

Type@100ms "this types slower"
Type@20ms "this types faster"

Type "back to normal speed"
```

### Speed Units

- `ms` — milliseconds (e.g., `50ms`)
- `s` — seconds (e.g., `0.5s`)

### Important Notes

- Speed is the **delay between keystrokes**, not total duration
- Default global speed: typically 50ms per character
- Shorter @time values = faster typing
- Longer @time values = slower, more visible typing

### Example Progression

```tape
Type@500ms "Very slow, character by character"
Sleep 1s
Type@50ms "Normal pace, readable"
Sleep 1s
Type@10ms "Fast, barely visible"
```

---

## 5. Wait Command Details

### Wait for Prompt Pattern (Default)

```tape
Wait        # Waits for />/$ prompt (default regex)
```

### Wait for Custom Pattern

```tape
Wait /pattern here/
Wait /Error/
Wait /Connection established/
Wait /Ready/
```

### Optional Timeout

```tape
Set WaitTimeout 30s
Wait /done/
```

---

```tape

Output demo.gif

# Dependencies (fail early if missing)
Require bash
Require echo

# Display & Recording Settings
Set Shell "bash"
Set FontSize 32
Set Width 1200
Set Height 600
Set Padding 10
Set Margin 5
Set BorderRadius 8
Set WindowBar Colorful
Set Theme "Dracula"
Set Framerate 30
Set PlaybackSpeed 1.0
Set TypingSpeed 50ms

# Typing example

Sleep 500ms
Enter
Sleep 2s

# Typing with custom speed
Type@100ms "Slower demonstration text"
Enter
Sleep 1s

# Fast typing
Type@20ms "Quick text entry"
Enter
Sleep 1s

# Navigation & Control
Type "ls -la"
Enter
Sleep 2s

# Arrow keys
Down 3
Sleep 500ms
Up 2
Sleep 500ms

# Keyboard shortcuts
Ctrl+C
Sleep 500ms

# Clear and cleanup
Type "clear"
Enter
Sleep 1s

# Scrolling
ScrollDown 5
Sleep 1s
ScrollUp 3
Sleep 1s

# End with message
Type "echo 'Recording complete!'"
Enter
Sleep 3s
```

---

## 7. Other Useful Features & Patterns

### Hide/Show for Setup (Don't Record)

```tape
Hide
# These commands won't be recorded
cd /some/directory
source setup.sh
Show

# Now recording resumes
Type "Ready to record!"
Enter
```

### Clipboard Operations

```tape
Copy "important text"
Sleep 500ms
Paste
```

### Screenshot Frame

```tape
Type "some command"
Enter

```

### Conditional Typing (Using Env)

```tape
Env DEBUG 1
Type "Some debug output"
Enter
```

### Source Other Tapes (Reusable Components)

**main.tape:**
```tape

Type "main workflow here"
Enter
```

**setup.tape:**
```tape

```

### Wait with Complex Patterns

```tape

```

- **PlaybackSpeed 0.5** = slow motion (half speed)
- **PlaybackSpeed 2.0** = fast forward (double speed)
- **PlaybackSpeed 1.0** = normal speed

## 4. Type Command Details

### Basic Typing

```tape
Type "hello world"
```

### Per-Command Speed Override

Override the global `TypingSpeed` for a single command:

```tape
Set TypingSpeed 50ms          # Default speed
Type "normal speed text"

Type@100ms "this types slower"
Type@20ms "this types faster"

Type "back to normal speed"
```

### Speed Units

- `ms` — milliseconds (e.g., `50ms`)
- `s` — seconds (e.g., `0.5s`)

### Important Notes

- Speed is the **delay between keystrokes**, not total duration
- Default global speed: typically 50ms per character
- Shorter @time values = faster typing
- Longer @time values = slower, more visible typing

### Example Progression

```tape

Sleep 1s
Type@50ms "Normal pace, readable"
Sleep 1s
Type@10ms "Fast, barely visible"
```

1	package game
2	
3	import (
4		"strings"
5		"time"
6	
7		tea "github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea"
8		"github.com/charmbracelet/lipgloss"
9	
10		"github.com/davidojeda/sudoku-tui/internal/board"
11		"github.com/davidojeda/sudoku-tui/internal/msgs"
12		"github.com/davidojeda/sudoku-tui/internal/session"
13		"github.com/davidojeda/sudoku-tui/internal/techniques"
14		"github.com/davidojeda/sudoku-tui/internal/theme"
15	)
16	
17	// InputMode is digit or note mode.
18	type InputMode int
19	
20	const (
21		ModDigit InputMode = iota
22		ModNote
23	)
24	
25	// undoEntry records a cell state for undo.
26	type undoEntry struct {
27		row, col int
28		oldValue int
29		oldKind  board.CellKind
30		oldNotes [9]bool
31	}
32	
33	// toastState manages the technique detection toast.
34	type toastState struct {
35		message string
36		expires time.Time
37		visible bool
38	}
39	
40	// Model is the game screen model.
41	type Model struct {
42		board         *board.Board
43		cursor        [2]int
44		inputMode     InputMode
45		undoStack     []undoEntry
46		timer         timerState
47		toast         toastState
48		celebration   celebrationState
49		solved        bool
50		width         int
51		height        int
52		difficulty    string
53		puzzleID      string
54		puzzle        string
55		solution      string
56		resumeElapsed int64
57		theme         *theme.Theme
58		snap          techniques.Snapshot
59	}
60	
61	// New creates a new game model.
62	func New(puzzle, solution, difficulty, puzzleID string, th *theme.Theme) *Model {
63		b := board.New()
64		b.LoadGivens(puzzle)
65	
66		for i, ch := range solution {
67			if ch >= '1' && ch <= '9' {
68				b.Solution[i/9][i%9] = int(ch - '0')
69			}
70		}
71	
72		m := &Model{
73			board:       b,
74			difficulty:  difficulty,
75			puzzleID:    puzzleID,
76			puzzle:      puzzle,
77			solution:    solution,
78			theme:       th,
79			celebration: newCelebration(th.Victory.Particle),
80		}
81		m.snap = techniques.TakeSnapshot(b)
82		return m
83	}
84	
85	// NewFromSaved restores a game from a previously saved session.
86	func NewFromSaved(saved *session.SavedGame, th *theme.Theme) *Model {
87		b := board.New()
88		b.LoadGivens(saved.Puzzle)
89		for i, ch := range saved.Solution {
90			if ch >= '1' && ch <= '9' {
91				b.Solution[i/9][i%9] = int(ch - '0')
92			}
93		}
94		for r := 0; r < 9; r++ {
95			for c := 0; c < 9; c++ {
96				cs := saved.Cells[r][c]
97				b.Cells[r][c].Value = cs.Value
98				b.Cells[r][c].Kind = board.CellKind(cs.Kind)
99				b.Cells[r][c].Notes = cs.Notes
100			}
101		}
102		b.UpdateConflicts()
103	
104		m := &Model{
105			board:         b,
106			difficulty:    saved.Difficulty,
107			puzzleID:      saved.PuzzleID,
108			puzzle:        saved.Puzzle,
109			solution:      saved.Solution,
110			resumeElapsed: saved.Elapsed,
111			theme:         th,
112			celebration:   newCelebration(th.Victory.Particle),
113		}
114		m.snap = techniques.TakeSnapshot(b)
115		return m
116	}
117	
118	// Snapshot captures the current game state for persistence.
119	func (m *Model) Snapshot() *session.SavedGame {
120		var cells [9][9]session.CellState
121		for r := 0; r < 9; r++ {
122			for c := 0; c < 9; c++ {
123				cell := m.board.Cells[r][c]
124				cells[r][c] = session.CellState{
125					Value: cell.Value,
126					Kind:  int(cell.Kind),
127					Notes: cell.Notes,
128				}
129			}
130		}
131		return &session.SavedGame{
132			Puzzle:     m.puzzle,
133			Solution:   m.solution,
134			Difficulty: m.difficulty,
135			PuzzleID:   m.puzzleID,
136			Elapsed:    m.timer.elapsedSeconds(),
137			Cells:      cells,
138		}
139	}
140	
141	// SetTheme updates the theme on the game screen.
142	func (m *Model) SetTheme(th *theme.Theme) { m.theme = th }
143	
144	// Init starts the timer and returns the first tick command.
145	func (m *Model) Init() tea.Cmd {
146		if m.resumeElapsed > 0 {
147			return m.timer.startAt(time.Duration(m.resumeElapsed) * time.Second)
148		}
149		return m.timer.start()
150	}
151	
152	// Update handles messages.
153	func (m *Model) Update(msg tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
154		switch msg := msg.(type) {
155		case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
156			m.width = msg.Width
157			m.height = msg.Height
158	
159		case tickMsg:
160			if m.solved {
161				m.celebration.update()
162				if m.celebration.active {
163					return m, tickCmd()
164				}
165				return m, nil
166			}
167			return m, m.timer.tick()
168	
169		case tea.KeyMsg:
170			if m.solved {
171				switch msg.String() {
172				case "enter", "esc":
173					elapsed := m.timer.elapsedSeconds()
174					diff := m.difficulty
175					return m, func() tea.Msg {
176						return msgs.GameOverMsg{Won: true, Elapsed: elapsed, Diff: diff}
177					}
178				}
179				return m, nil
180			}
181			cmd := m.handleKey(msg)
182			return m, cmd
183	
184		case tea.FocusMsg:
185			return m, m.timer.resume()
186	
187		case tea.BlurMsg:
188			m.timer.pause()
189			return m, nil
190		}
191	
192		return m, nil
193	}
194	
195	// View renders the game screen.
196	func (m *Model) View() string {
197		if m.width < 80 || m.height < 24 {
198			return lipgloss.Place(m.width, m.height, lipgloss.Center, lipgloss.Center,
199				"Terminal too small.\nPlease resize to at least 80x24.")
200		}
201	
202		if m.solved {
203			return m.renderSolved()
204		}
205	
206		return m.renderGame()
207	}
208	
209	// ElapsedSeconds returns the total elapsed seconds.
210	func (m *Model) ElapsedSeconds() int64 {
211		return m.timer.elapsedSeconds()
212	}
213	
214	// Difficulty returns the game difficulty string.
215	func (m *Model) Difficulty() string {
216		return m.difficulty
217	}
218	
219	// placeDigit places a digit (or note) at the cursor.
220	func (m *Model) placeDigit(digit int, forceNote bool) {
221		r, c := m.cursor[0], m.cursor[1]
222		cell := m.board.Cells[r][c]
223		if cell.Kind == board.KindGiven {
224			return
225		}
226	
227		m.undoStack = append(m.undoStack, undoEntry{
228			row: r, col: c,
229			oldValue: cell.Value,
230			oldKind:  cell.Kind,
231			oldNotes: cell.Notes,
232		})
233	
234		isNote := forceNote || m.inputMode == ModNote
235		if isNote {
236			m.board.ToggleNote(r, c, digit)
237		} else {
238			m.snap = techniques.TakeSnapshot(m.board)
239			m.board.Set(r, c, digit)
240		}
241	}
242	
243	func (m *Model) eraseCell() {
244		r, c := m.cursor[0], m.cursor[1]
245		cell := m.board.Cells[r][c]
246		if cell.Kind == board.KindGiven {
247			return
248		}
249		m.undoStack = append(m.undoStack, undoEntry{
250			row: r, col: c,
251			oldValue: cell.Value,
252			oldKind:  cell.Kind,
253			oldNotes: cell.Notes,
254		})
255		m.board.Erase(r, c)
256	}
257	
258	func (m *Model) undo() {
259		if len(m.undoStack) == 0 {
260			return
261		}
262		last := m.undoStack[len(m.undoStack)-1]
263		m.undoStack = m.undoStack[:len(m.undoStack)-1]
264	
265		cell := &m.board.Cells[last.row][last.col]
266		cell.Value = last.oldValue
267		cell.Kind = last.oldKind
268		cell.Notes = last.oldNotes
269		m.board.UpdateConflicts()
270	}
271	
272	func (m *Model) checkTechnique() tea.Cmd {
273		r, c := m.cursor[0], m.cursor[1]
274		val := m.board.Cells[r][c].Value
275		if val == 0 {
276			return nil
277		}
278	
279		tech := techniques.DetectTechnique(m.board, m.snap, r, c, val)
280		if tech != techniques.TechNone {
281			m.toast = toastState{
282				message: tech.Message(),
283				expires: time.Now().Add(3 * time.Second),
284				visible: true,
285			}
286		}
287	
288		if m.board.IsSolved() {
289			m.solved = true
290			m.timer.pause()
291			m.celebration.start(m.width, m.height)
292			return tickCmd()
293		}
294	
295		return nil
296	}
297	
298	func (m *Model) cursorValue() int {
299		return m.board.Cells[m.cursor[0]][m.cursor[1]].Value
300	}
301	
302	// renderGame renders the main game layout.
303	func (m *Model) renderGame() string {
304		header := m.renderHeader()
305		footer := m.renderFooter()
306	
307		bodyHeight := m.height - lipgloss.Height(header) - lipgloss.Height(footer)
308	
309		boardStr := m.renderBoard()
310		sidebar := m.renderSidebar()
311	
312		toast := ""
313		if m.toast.visible && time.Now().Before(m.toast.expires) {
314			toast = m.renderToast()
315		} else {
316			m.toast.visible = false
317		}
318	
319		toastHeight := lipgloss.Height(m.renderToast())
320		bodyHeight -= toastHeight
321	
322		body := lipgloss.JoinHorizontal(lipgloss.Top, boardStr, "  ", sidebar)
323		body = lipgloss.NewStyle().Height(bodyHeight).Render(body)
